title: [YSQL] parameterized filter selectivity not taken into account in yb_cost_bitmap_table_scan because path->rows is overwritten incorrectly
body:
Jira Link: [DB-14968](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-14968)
### Description

the value of path->rows is set [here](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/blame/9d2e4745e19ff71eaf2861c2ea37410d113120e4/src/postgres/src/backend/optimizer/path/costsize.c#L8457) then overwritten immediately after.  So, the final path->rows wouldn't reflect any local filter.

furthermore, parameterized predicates are not taken into account even if it wasn't overwritten there.  it's best not to recompute it once the value is set at the beginning of the function as shown below:

```
	/* Mark the path with the correct row estimate */
	if (param_info)
		path->rows = param_info->ppi_rows;
	else
		path->rows = baserel->rows;
```

In the example below, row count estimates of `BitmapOr` and `YB Bitmap Table Scan` are both 626, indicating that ` Storage Filter: ((a + b) >= s.y)` (internally looks like `((a + b) >= $1)` in `yb_cost_bitmap_table_scan`) is not taken into account.
```
set yb_enable_base_scans_cost_model = on;
set yb_enable_bitmapscan = on;
set enable_bitmapscan = on;
set yb_prefer_bnl = off;

/*+ Leading((s r)) NestLoop(s r) BitmapScan(r) */
explain select * from r, s where (a = x or c <= 'b') and a + b >= y;

                                     QUERY PLAN                                     
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Nested Loop  (cost=1359.45..349378.53 rows=25652 width=4142)
   ->  Seq Scan on s  (cost=10.00..39.98 rows=123 width=19)
   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on r  (cost=1349.45..2833.89 rows=626 width=4123)
         Storage Filter: ((a + b) >= s.y)
         ->  BitmapOr  (cost=439.82..439.82 rows=626 width=0)
               ->  Bitmap Index Scan on i_r_a  (cost=0.00..38.49 rows=5 width=0)
                     Index Cond: (a = s.x)
               ->  Bitmap Index Scan on i_r_c  (cost=0.00..398.19 rows=621 width=0)
                     Index Cond: (c <= 'b'::bpchar)
(9 rows)
```

```
	path->rows =
		clamp_row_est(baserel->tuples *
					  clauselist_selectivity(root, baserel->baserestrictinfo,
											 baserel->relid, JOIN_INNER, NULL));

	path->rows = tuples_fetched;
```

As shown on the debugger session snippet below, stopped at the line: `path->rows = tuples_fetched;`, neither of these statements above is correct.  Both them should be simply removed.  Also, `path->rows` is properly adjusted for parallel scan when it reaches here after the fix for #25185.

```
(lldb)  br list
br list
Current breakpoints:
3: file = 'costsize.c', line = 8803, exact_match = 0, locations = 1, resolved = 1, hit count = 6
    Breakpoint commands:
      p param_info? param_info->ppi_rows: baserel->rows
      p baserel->baserestrictinfo
      p path->rows
      p tuples_fetched
      c

  3.1: where = postgres`yb_cost_bitmap_table_scan + 2524 at costsize.c:8803:15, address = 0x00000001085362cc, resolved, hit count = 6 
(lldb) (lldb)  p param_info? param_info->ppi_rows: baserel->rows
(Cardinality) 209
(lldb)  (lldb)  p baserel->baserestrictinfo
(List *) NULL
(lldb)  (lldb)  p path->rows
(Cardinality) 12345
(lldb)  (lldb)  p tuples_fetched
(double) 626
(lldb)  (lldb)  c
Process 54889 resuming
(lldb)  Command #5 'c' continued the target.
(lldb)  (lldb)  p param_info? param_info->ppi_rows: baserel->rows
(Cardinality) 209
(lldb)  (lldb)  p baserel->baserestrictinfo
(List *) NULL
(lldb)  (lldb)  p path->rows
(Cardinality) 12345
(lldb)  (lldb)  p tuples_fetched
(double) 626
(lldb)  (lldb)  c
Process 54889 resuming
(lldb)  Command #5 'c' continued the target.
```


**After removing these 2 statements shown above**, the estimate for `YB Bitmap Table Scan` is 209, 1/3 (the default selectivity of range predicates) of the estimate for the `BitmapOr`.
```
                                     QUERY PLAN                                     
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Nested Loop  (cost=1359.45..348865.62 rows=25652 width=4142)
   ->  Seq Scan on s  (cost=10.00..39.98 rows=123 width=19)
   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on r  (cost=1349.45..2833.89 rows=209 width=4123)
         Storage Filter: ((a + b) >= s.y)
         ->  BitmapOr  (cost=439.82..439.82 rows=626 width=0)
               ->  Bitmap Index Scan on i_r_a  (cost=0.00..38.49 rows=5 width=0)
                     Index Cond: (a = s.x)
               ->  Bitmap Index Scan on i_r_c  (cost=0.00..398.19 rows=621 width=0)
                     Index Cond: (c <= 'b'::bpchar)
(9 rows)
```
#### Test Case

```
drop table if exists r, s;
create table r (pk int, a int, b int, c char(10), v char(1024), primary key (pk asc));
create table s (x int, y int, z char(10));
create index i_r_a on r (a asc);
create index i_r_b on r (b asc);
create unique index ui_r_b on r (b asc);
create index i_r_c on r (c asc);

insert into r
  select
    i, i / 5, i,
    -- 'aaa', 'aab', 'aac', ...
    concat(chr((((i-1)/26/26) % 26) + ascii('a')),
           chr((((i-1)/26) % 26) + ascii('a')),
           chr(((i-1) % 26) + ascii('a')))
  from generate_series(1, 12345) i;

insert into s
  select
    i / 3, i,
    concat(chr((((i-1)/26/26) % 26) + ascii('a')),
           chr((((i-1)/26) % 26) + ascii('a')),
           chr(((i-1) % 26) + ascii('a')))
  from generate_series(1, 123) i;

analyze r, s;

set yb_enable_base_scans_cost_model = on;
set yb_enable_bitmapscan = on;
set enable_bitmapscan = on;
set yb_prefer_bnl = off;

/*+ Leading((s r)) NestLoop(s r) BitmapScan(r) */
explain select * from r, s where (a = x or c <= 'b') and a + b >= y;
```
